evidence_type: prior source observation; not a fresh reproduction
limitations: Feasibility prototype, not production security certification or general-purpose agent execution service.
macOS Seatbelt via deprecated sandbox_init is a feasibility dependency; direct sandbox-exec failed during dynamic-loader startup.
System/Python contents and general filesystem metadata remain readable; metadata secrecy is not promised.
No CPU/memory isolation or hostile native-code escape resistance is qualified.
Synthetic scripted probes are not proof against every malicious agent; no LLM reliability, grant acceptance, concept benchmark, Linux isolation, or shared deployment is claimed.
Read denials are based on probe OS exceptions, not independent kernel tracing.
Input/export roots must be privately owned and not mutated by a hostile host; receipts are local and not tamper-proof against the trusted host.
Capability expiry uses wall-clock time; restart recovery and clock rollback resistance are future work.
Historical test evidence; publication does not represent grant submission or approval.
